adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.management_rationale: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: This is a pro-forma annualization rather than a historical FY2025 earnings adjustment. Further, SQL shows FY2025 customers with first contract start dates in 2025 generated $7.804M of FY2025 invoiced revenue in aggregate, but the specific annualization methodology for $1.65M is not supported. Document evidence also contradicts at least one new-logo characterization: Cascade Foods Holdings is described in management summary as a new logo win FY2025, while the executed MSA recitals reference a prior 2021 agreement through an operating subsidiary, indicating re-engagement rather than a wholly new logo. The adjustment is therefore both pro-forma and evidentially unreliable.

existence.finding: FY2025 customer wins exist in structured data, with 29 customers showing first contract starts in 2025 and $7.804M FY2025 invoiced revenue, but the specific annualized EBITDA effect is not evidenced.

amount.finding: No SQL-queryable margin build, EBITDA conversion, or customer-level annualization schedule supports the $1.65M amount.

period.finding: The adjustment annualizes in-year wins beyond FY2025 actual results, making it pro-forma rather than historical period normalization.

recurrence.finding: No prior-year history for this category identified.

underlying_data.finding: Underlying customer data shows new-logo activity but also identifies a contradiction for Cascade Foods Holdings, which documents prior relationship context inconsistent with clean new-logo treatment.

document_support.finding: Management summary labels Cascade Foods Holdings a new logo, but executed contract recitals show a prior 2021 agreement through an operating subsidiary; this undermines the reliability of the new-logo narrative used in the pro-forma annualization.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Customer-level annualization model, gross margin/EBITDA conversion support, booking-to-revenue bridge, and clear evidence separating true new logos from reactivations/re-engagements.

sql_evidence.purpose: Validate management adjustment source and retrieve all adjustment history for recurrence and bridge testing.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT * FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment ORDER BY fiscal_year, adjustment_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: Returned 10 adjustment rows across FY2023-FY2025, including FY2025 rows ADJ-003, ADJ-004, ADJ-005, ADJ-006, ADJ-007, ADJ-009, and ADJ-010.

sql_evidence.purpose: Validate DDL-driven physical objects for products, invoices, invoice lines, subscription snapshots, support tickets, and claims.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT table_catalog, table_schema, table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'aava_deal_studio' AND table_name IN ('fact_invoice','fact_invoice_line','dim_product','fact_subscription_month','fact_support_ticket','mgmt_claim') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position
sql_evidence.result_summary: Confirmed required physical objects and relevant columns exist for revenue, product, ARR, operational, and claim testing.

sql_evidence.purpose: Reconcile reported EBITDA plus FY2025 management adjustments to management Adjusted EBITDA.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH fy25 AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd, mgmt_rationale FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ), bridge AS ( SELECT CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) AS reported_ebitda_usd, SUM(amount_usd) AS management_adjustments_total_usd FROM fy25 ) SELECT reported_ebitda_usd, management_adjustments_total_usd, reported_ebitda_usd + management_adjustments_total_usd AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, CAST(12400000 AS DOUBLE) AS stated_mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, (reported_ebitda_usd + management_adjustments_total_usd) - CAST(12400000 AS DOUBLE) AS reconciliation_difference_usd FROM bridge
sql_evidence.result_summary: Reported EBITDA $4.28M plus FY2025 management adjustments $8.12M equals $12.4M management Adjusted EBITDA; reconciliation difference $0.

sql_evidence.purpose: Test recurrence of adjustment categories using full available adjustment history.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH hist AS ( SELECT fiscal_year, adjustment_id, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd, mgmt_rationale FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment ), recurrence AS ( SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year_count, SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS fy2025_amount_usd, COLLECT_SET(fiscal_year) AS fiscal_years FROM hist GROUP BY category ) SELECT * FROM recurrence ORDER BY category
sql_evidence.result_summary: One-time legal settlement appears in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025; transaction costs appear in FY2024 and FY2025; other FY2025 categories appear once in available history.

sql_evidence.purpose: Retrieve claim record relevant to management Adjusted EBITDA claim CLM-05.
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT claim_id, claim_text, metric_key, claimed_value, period, cim_page FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_claim WHERE claim_id = 'CLM-05' OR lower(claim_text) LIKE '%adjusted ebitda%' ORDER BY claim_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: Retrieved CLM-05: Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M for FY2025.

sql_evidence.purpose: Test whether a Legacy or On-Prem product exists in FY2025 product revenue data.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH product_2025 AS ( SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_family, p.delivery_model, SUM(CAST(il.line_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS fy2025_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_family, p.delivery_model ) SELECT * FROM product_2025 WHERE lower(product_name) LIKE '%legacy%' OR lower(product_family) LIKE '%legacy%' OR lower(product_name) LIKE '%on-prem%' OR lower(delivery_model) LIKE '%on-prem%' ORDER BY fy2025_revenue_usd DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: Returned zero rows; no product matching Legacy or On-Prem descriptors was found in queryable FY2025 product data.

sql_evidence.purpose: Quantify FY2025 customers with first contract start dates in 2025 as a test of the new-logo annualization narrative.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH fy25_new AS ( SELECT dc.customer_id, dc.customer_name, MIN(to_date(c.contract_start_date)) AS first_contract_start, SUM(CASE WHEN year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 THEN CAST(i.invoice_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS fy2025_invoiced_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract c ON dc.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON dc.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY dc.customer_id, dc.customer_name HAVING MIN(to_date(c.contract_start_date)) >= DATE '2025-01-01' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS fy2025_new_logo_count, SUM(fy2025_invoiced_usd) AS fy2025_new_logo_invoiced_usd, COLLECT_LIST(named_struct('customer_id', customer_id, 'customer_name', customer_name, 'first_contract_start', first_contract_start, 'fy2025_invoiced_usd', fy2025_invoiced_usd)) AS customers FROM fy25_new
sql_evidence.result_summary: Identified 29 customers with first contract starts in 2025 and aggregate FY2025 invoiced revenue of $7.804M; this does not independently support management's $1.65M EBITDA annualization.

sql_evidence.purpose: List FY2025 new-logo candidate customers and quantify invoiced revenue for underlying-data review.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH invoices_2025 AS ( SELECT i.customer_id, dc.customer_name, SUM(CAST(i.invoice_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS fy2025_invoiced_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON i.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY i.customer_id, dc.customer_name ), contracts AS ( SELECT customer_id, MIN(to_date(contract_start_date)) AS first_contract_start FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract GROUP BY customer_id ) SELECT i.customer_id, i.customer_name, c.first_contract_start, i.fy2025_invoiced_usd FROM invoices_2025 i JOIN contracts c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.first_contract_start >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY i.fy2025_invoiced_usd DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: Top FY2025 first-start customers include Pinnacle Outdoor ($5.013M invoiced) and Cascade Foods Holdings ($1.206M invoiced); customer list informs testing of management's new-logo characterization.

sql_evidence.purpose: Calculate Team Adjusted EBITDA and earnings challenge using retained accepted amounts only.
sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH accepted AS ( SELECT * FROM VALUES ('ADJ-003', 0.0D), ('ADJ-004', 0.0D), ('ADJ-005', 0.0D), ('ADJ-006', 870000.0D), ('ADJ-007', 0.0D), ('ADJ-009', 310000.0D), ('ADJ-010', 0.0D) AS accepted(adjustment_id, accepted_amount_usd) ), mgmt AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ) SELECT CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) AS reported_ebitda_usd, SUM(m.amount_usd) AS management_adjustments_total_usd, CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) + SUM(m.amount_usd) AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS accepted_adjustments_total_usd, SUM(m.amount_usd) - SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS challenged_or_rejected_adjustments_total_usd, CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) + SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, (CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) + SUM(m.amount_usd)) - (CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) + SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd)) AS earnings_challenge_usd FROM mgmt m LEFT JOIN accepted a ON m.adjustment_id = a.adjustment_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: Accepted adjustments total $1.18M, Team Adjusted EBITDA equals $5.46M, and earnings challenge versus management Adjusted EBITDA equals $6.94M.
